title: Crew Connections
summary: Sector review on the Crew Log: do astronauts who fly more missions log more spacewalk hours, and is military status related to nationality? Correlation, regression and χ², one row per astronaut.
hints: `group_by(number) |> summarise(missions = n(), eva_hours = sum(eva_hrs_mission), military_civilian = first(military_civilian), nationality = first(nationality))`.
`case_when(nationality %in% c("U.S.", "U.S.S.R/Russia") ~ nationality, .default = "Other")`. Spearman: `cor.test(people$missions, people$eva_hours, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)`.
`lm(eva_hours ~ missions, data = people)`; `table(people$nation, people$military_civilian)`; `chisq.test(crosstab)` (no Yates for a 3 × 2 table); `cramers_v(crosstab, adjust = FALSE)`.
